§3§lWallet and physical coins§r
Place coins in an input slot and use import to turn them into wallet balance. Export converts balance back into physical coins. With a valid ME connection, coins can also be imported from or exported to the network.

§3§lPersonal and team wallets§r
Players without a team use their personal wallet. Joining a team automatically switches access to its shared wallet. Personal balances remain separate and become accessible again after leaving; joining does not transfer them into the team wallet.

§3§lCompletion§r
View the wallet interface and understand import, export and sharing, then tick the checkbox.
